ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels to high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The central peduncle attachment area and leading edges are dominated by solid low-intensity black regions. Both lateral lobes feature large contiguous high-intensity white regions that are heavily interspersed with irregular black mottling and focal spots, primarily concentrated towards the central notch and trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 45-50 degrees and a depth reaching roughly 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge; the left lobe displays higher-amplitude, more irregular jagged peaks compared to the relatively smoother serrations on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory originating from the median notch transitioning into a convex curve towards the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, circular pixel clusters (mottling) scattered across the high-intensity white regions; high-contrast yellowish-brown clusters are localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark vertical linear disruptions visible on the white region of the left lobe; a few faint diagonal linear marks are detectable on the inner portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized yellowish-brown clusters at the distal tips indicative of barnacle colonization or parasitic lesions; visible physical wear and irregular chipping on the trailing edge serrations.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique yellowish coloration at the distal tips provides a high-contrast visual marker distinct from the standard black and white pigmentation.
